title: Ugramm
desc: Agastya, an automobile mechanic with a dangerous past, takes it upon himself to protect Nithya, a kidnapped girl, from the vengeful son of a ruthless gangster.

title: Maharaja
desc: Rajashekhar has two sons, Surya and Kiran, but Surya is adopted. Surya is very hardworking and makes many sacrifices for the family, thereby inciting jealousy in his brother Kiran's heart.
A gangster deploys two of his trusted men in different cities to extort money from people who have escaped. While on their mission, they find themselves in various adventurous situations.

title: Appu
desc: After falling in love with Suchitra, Appu must go against the odds to win her over and marry her despite her father's disapproval of him.

title: Gowramma
desc: Venky, a boy from a small town, comes to the city in pursuit of education. His father wants him to do a productive job and sends him to the city to get a job at a friend's place.
